_doc: Drafting profile = every office-specific constant a recipe needs. New office/drawing type: copy this file, change values, pass --profile NAME. Evidence for each value: conventions/sections-drawing.md, office-standards.md
name: israeli-structural

cut_mark.view_dir: local +y rotated by the insert rotation (rot 270 east, 180 south, 0 north)

beam_section_doc: Constants of recipes/ledge_beam.py (hollow-core beam sections + stirrup detail row + cast L), measured on the user's ground-floor examples and corrected by the user; keys are the constant names in the recipe, any key present here overrides the default. Evidence: conventions/sections-drawing.md
examples_box_doc: region (x0, y0, x1, y1) of the user's finished example sheet; note-text styles/heights are copied from the first matching text found there

plan._doc: regexes of the labels on the structural plan: beam b/h in cm, hollow-core slab D=panel+topping ; span_leader_layer = layer of the double arrow drawn beside the slab label = panel span direction

general_sections._doc: General sections the user drew once and wants REUSED (copy_region.py --general N), with the box of their drawing in the user's file and where their marks go.

stirrup_tables._doc: User's two tables (images pasted into sections_ramla.dxf, 2026-10-15): key = beam thickness 'עובי קורה' = width of the stirrup-bearing part (stem), cm, step 5; value = [number of stirrups 'מס' חישוקים', width of each stirrup 'רוחב חישוקים' cm]. n=1 -> width = key-6. Verified: ex 5-5 (stem 85 -> 3 x 35, standard) and ex 2-2 (stem 50 -> 2 x 30, TRANSFER). Stirrups are spread evenly over key-6 (first starts 3 from the face, last ends 3 from the other face).
